notes: The adapter is complete and executable, but per the frozen input manifest (assets_ready=false, gate: native LAMMPS/Kokkos/CUDA binary and Ta06A SNAP files not mounted) `doctor` reports every required file plus the kokkos/cuda/snap/kk capability tokens as missing and exits 78; `run` and `resume` refuse to start and never claim acceptance. No CPU lmp, Lennard-Jones substitute, analytic RDF or fabricated input is used anywhere. When the declared assets are mounted, `run` copies the upstream tree into output/workspace, adapts in.snap.Ta06A to nrep=4 with dump/thermo/write_restart instrumentation only, executes `lmp -k on g 1 -sf kk -pk kokkos -in ...` for 100 steps, and saves initial.data, final.restart, full per-atom trajectory.dump, thermo.csv, an RDF recomputed from the saved frames, structure_stats.json and run.json with real timings, hashes, device info and log-based GPU proof. `resume` rebuilds a continuation from final.restart preserving velocities, box, SNAP+ZBL potential, timestep and neighbor settings, runs the declared 50 debug steps and emits incremental RDF/statistics and a new restart. Only the debug scale is implemented; the reference-large 65536-atom / 50 ps instance is explicitly not executed.
